title: Is the Sea Around Funchal Crowded With Boats in Summer?
description: Not like a Mediterranean bay, but you are not alone. In July and August boats bunch up under Cabo Girão as shared trips arrive. Evenings and June are calmer.
heroAlt: A large catamaran in the distance under Cabo Girão, seen from the bow of a small boat
keywords: is the sea around Funchal crowded with boats in summer
quietest time for a boat trip Madeira

images.prompt: Mid-morning in August under Cabo Girão, Madeira. Taken from the empty bow of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, which fills the lower edge of the frame. A few hundred metres ahead, a large white sightseeing catamaran with many small figures on deck lies stopped near the foot of the towering brown cliff, which rises to the top of the image. Between the two boats, a wide stretch of calm, deep blue water. Bright summer sun, light haze along the cliff top. Realistic photograph, no faces, true colours.
images.alt: A large catamaran in the distance under Cabo Girão, seen from the bow of a small boat

images.prompt: Early evening seen from a white motor boat off Cabo Girão, Madeira: the cliff glowing orange in low sun, the sea calm and empty of other boats, a single guest seen from behind sitting at the side of the boat looking at the cliff. Realistic photograph, natural colours.
images.alt: The cliff of Cabo Girão at golden hour with no other boats in sight

images.prompt: Mid-morning at the mouth of Marina do Funchal, Madeira, seen from a high point on the seafront: several boats of different sizes, a catamaran, a small white motor boat and a sailing yacht, fanning out in different directions on the blue sea, white wakes spreading. Realistic photograph, true colours, no logos.
images.alt: Boats fanning out in different directions after leaving Marina do Funchal
